flow.name: support-agent-main-flow
flow.doc:name: Order Support Agent Flow
flow.doc:description: A2A agent: receives a task, lets OpenAI pick MCP tools, runs them, then returns the final answer

a2a:task-listener.doc:name: A2A Task Listener
a2a:task-listener.doc:description: Recebe tasks A2A do Order Support Agent (blocking, non-blocking e streaming)

ee:transform.doc:name: Extract task vars
ee:transform.doc:description: Extracts taskId, contextId and the user prompt text from the incoming A2A task

logger.doc:name: Flow start
logger.doc:description: Logs START tracePoint with the taskId and the user prompt
logger.message: #[output application/json --- {message: 'A2A task received', tracePoint: 'START'} ++ ({ taskId: vars.taskId, userPrompt: vars.userPrompt })]

ee:transform.doc:name: Set system prompt e tool defs
ee:transform.doc:description: Stores the system prompt and the tool catalogue as vars, reused by every round of the tool-calling loop

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- "Voce e o agente de suporte de pedidos da TechWave Electronics. " ++ "Responda em portugues, de forma curta e objetiva. " ++ "Use as tools disponiveis para consultar pedidos, abrir cases, processar reembolsos e notificar o time. " ++ "Nunca invente dados de pedidos: sempre consulte get-order-status primeiro. " ++ "GUARDRAIL DE REEMBOLSO: antes de chamar refund-payment, verifique o payment.status retornado por get-order-status. " ++ "Se o pagamento ja estiver como refunded, NAO chame refund-payment: informe educadamente que o reembolso ja foi processado e nao crie um novo. " ++ "Trabalhe em etapas: peca uma tool de cada vez quando o resultado da proxima depender da anterior. " ++ "Apos criar um case ou reembolso, notifique o time com notify-team antes de dar a resposta final."

ee:transform.doc:name: Build OpenAI request (with tools)
ee:transform.doc:description: Builds the first OpenAI request with the system prompt, user prompt and the tool catalogue

logger.doc:name: Before OpenAI call 1
logger.doc:description: Logs BEFORE_REQUEST before the first OpenAI call (tool selection)

http:request.doc:name: OpenAI tool selection
http:request.doc:description: Calls OpenAI Responses API to decide which support tools to invoke

logger.doc:name: After OpenAI call 1
logger.doc:description: Logs AFTER_REQUEST with the number of tool calls OpenAI requested

flow-ref.name: support-agent-extract-llm-response
flow-ref.doc:name: Extract LLM response
flow-ref.doc:description: Reads responseId, tool calls and assistant text out of the Responses API payload

foreach.doc:name: Rodadas de tool-calling
foreach.doc:description: Runs at most maxToolIterations rounds; each round is skipped once the model stops asking for tools

choice.doc:name: Ainda há tools pendentes?
choice.doc:description: Executes another round only while the model keeps requesting tools

flow-ref.name: support-agent-tool-round
flow-ref.doc:name: Rodada de tool-calling
flow-ref.doc:description: Executes the pending MCP tools and feeds the results back to the LLM

choice.doc:name: Teto atingido?
choice.doc:description: Warns when maxToolIterations truncated the conversation with tool calls still pending

logger.doc:name: Log teto atingido
logger.doc:description: Logs the pending tools left unexecuted when the ceiling stopped the loop

logger.doc:name: Log fim do loop
logger.doc:description: Logs how many rounds the loop needed before the model answered with text

set-variable.value: #[vars.assistantText default 'Nao consegui concluir a solicitacao. Um atendente vai assumir o caso.']
set-variable.doc:name: Set finalAnswer
set-variable.doc:description: Uses the last assistant text; falls back to a handoff message when the loop ended without one

a2a:update-task-artifact.doc:name: Artifact: resposta ao cliente
a2a:update-task-artifact.doc:description: Publica a resposta final como artifact da task

a2a:update-task-status.doc:name: Status: completed
a2a:update-task-status.doc:description: Status terminal — dispara a materialização da resposta ao cliente

logger.doc:name: Flow end
logger.doc:description: Logs END tracePoint with the completed taskId
logger.message: #[output application/json --- {message: 'A2A task completed', tracePoint: 'END'} ++ ({ taskId: vars.taskId })]

logger.doc:name: Log agent error
logger.doc:description: Logs EXCEPTION tracePoint with the error type and description on any failure

a2a:update-task-status.doc:name: Status: failed
a2a:update-task-status.doc:description: Status terminal de falha, com mensagem amigável ao cliente

sub-flow.name: support-agent-extract-llm-response
sub-flow.doc:name: Extract LLM response
sub-flow.doc:description: Extracts responseId, function_call items and assistant text from a Responses API payload

set-variable.doc:name: Set openaiResponseId
set-variable.doc:description: Stores the Responses API response id, used as previous_response_id on the next round

set-variable.doc:name: Set toolCalls
set-variable.doc:description: Stores the function_call output items still pending MCP execution

set-variable.doc:name: Set assistantText
set-variable.doc:description: Stores the assistant text, present only when the model stopped asking for tools

sub-flow.name: support-agent-tool-round
sub-flow.doc:name: Tool-calling round
sub-flow.doc:description: One round: executes the pending MCP tools and feeds their outputs back to the LLM

set-variable.doc:name: Increment toolIteration
set-variable.doc:description: Counts this round against the maxToolIterations ceiling

logger.doc:name: Loop round start
logger.doc:description: Logs the round number and which tools this round will execute

set-variable.doc:name: Reset toolResults
set-variable.doc:description: Clears the tool results list — only this round's outputs go back to the LLM

foreach.doc:name: For each tool call
foreach.doc:description: Iterates over every tool call the model requested in this round

set-variable.doc:name: Set currentCall
set-variable.doc:description: Stores the current tool call being processed

logger.doc:name: Before MCP tool call
logger.doc:description: Logs BEFORE_REQUEST with the name of the MCP tool about to be called

mcp:call-tool.doc:name: Call MCP tool
mcp:call-tool.doc:description: Invokes the named MCP tool on the TechWave Support MCP Server with the parsed arguments

ee:transform.doc:name: Extract MCP tool output
ee:transform.doc:description: Extracts the raw MCP text content for the OpenAI Responses function_call_output item

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var rawText = attributes.rawMcpResponse.contents[0].text default payload.contents[0].text default null --- rawText default write(payload, "application/json") default "sem resultado"

logger.doc:name: After MCP tool call
logger.doc:description: Logs AFTER_REQUEST once the MCP tool has responded

ee:transform.doc:name: Append tool result
ee:transform.doc:description: Appends the MCP tool result as a Responses API function_call_output keyed by call_id

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- vars.toolResults ++ [{ 'type': 'function_call_output', call_id: vars.currentCall.call_id, 'output': vars.toolOutput }]

ee:transform.doc:name: Build OpenAI request (tool results)
ee:transform.doc:description: Builds the follow-up request with this round's tool outputs and the tool catalogue

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { model: p('config.openai.model'), previous_response_id: vars.openaiResponseId, 'input': vars.toolResults, tools: vars.toolDefs }

logger.doc:name: Before OpenAI call (loop)
logger.doc:description: Logs BEFORE_REQUEST before feeding the tool results back to OpenAI
logger.message: #[output application/json --- {message: 'Calling OpenAI (tool results)', tracePoint: 'BEFORE_REQUEST'} ++ ({ round: vars.toolIteration })]

http:request.doc:name: OpenAI next step
http:request.doc:description: Calls OpenAI Responses API with the tool outputs to get the next tool call or the final answer

logger.doc:name: After OpenAI call (loop)
logger.doc:description: Logs AFTER_REQUEST with how many further tool calls the model asked for

flow-ref.name: support-agent-extract-llm-response
flow-ref.doc:name: Extract LLM response
flow-ref.doc:description: Reads responseId, tool calls and assistant text out of the Responses API payload
